provenance_note: Every entry sourced directly from sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine's own data/spells.jsonl (MIT-licensed, the same clone this project's Mage/Warlock packs used) - no WebSearch/community-reported values in this pack, only beta-datamine. See each spell's own `source` field for the exact spell id/rank and what's deliberately not modeled (backfire damage, player healing).

mind_blast.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 10947 'Mind Blast Rank 9'.

shadow_word_pain.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 10894 'Shadow Word: Pain Rank 8' - DurationMs 18000 / PeriodMs 3000 = 6 ticks (Improved Shadow Word: Pain, +1 tick/point, not talented in the real reference build this pack's own example build mirrors - see priest/shadow.rs).

devouring_plague.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 19280 'Devouring Plague Rank 6' - DurationMs 24000 / PeriodMs 3000 = 8 ticks. The real spell also heals the caster for a share of each tick's damage (`heal_metrics_tag` in the real engine's own prepared output) - not modeled, this project doesn't track player health/healing (DPS-only scope, same as every other class).

shadow_word_death.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 1309636 'Shadow Word: Death Rank 4'. The real spell also backfires on the caster for its own damage if the target survives (classic SW:Death's drawback) - not modeled, this project tracks no player health pool for any class. Early Demise's own +30% crit bonus (this build's own real `prepared` output gives `early_demise_crit: 30.0` directly) is modeled as a static crit bonus in priest/shadow.rs, not decoded from a talent curve.

mind_flay.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 18807 'Mind Flay Rank 6' - modeled as a 3000ms channel (DurationMs 3000, PeriodMs 1000 = 3 ticks), same `cast_time_ms`-as-channel-length convention `mage/arcane.rs`'s own `arcane_missiles` entry already uses. The real priority list clips this channel short (interrupts after 2 ticks) whenever Mind Blast comes off cooldown mid-channel - not modeled; this engine always resolves the full 3-tick channel, a known simplification (see priest/shadow.rs's own module docs).

smite_downrank.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 591 'Smite Rank 2' - the real priority list's own mana-saving downrank filler, cast instead of the full-rank Smite once the mana-pacing check (`currentManaPercent >= remainingTimePercent * 0.9`) fails - see priest/smite.rs.

holy_fire.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 15261 'Holy Fire Rank 8' - direct hit (BasePoints 208, SPCoef 0.75) plus its own dot (BasePoints 15/tick, SPCoef 0.05, PeriodMs 2000, DurationMs 10000 = 5 ticks), same direct+dot shape as Fire Mage's Pyroblast.

penance.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 1316995 'Penance Rank 4' (the channel cast) and its own damage-bolt sub-spell 1316993 (BasePoints 92, SPCoef 0.19) - Penance channels 2000ms with a 1000ms bolt period (2 bolts), confirmed against sub-spell 402261's own periodic effect (PeriodMs 1000 over a 2000ms DurationMs). The channel also has a separate heal-bolt variant (sub-spell 1316991, for a friendly target) not used by this DPS-only rotation.

inner_focus.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 14751 'Inner Focus' - a utility cast (no direct/periodic effect of its own; its real effect, -100% cost and +25% crit on the *next* qualifying cast, is applied in priest/shadow.rs and priest/smite.rs as a timed self-buff, not through this row). No GCDMs field on the real row at all - treated as the implicit 1500ms GCD default (same convention this project's own data packs already use for every other spell missing that field), not as explicitly off-GCD (which the real row would show as `GCDMs: 0`, confirmed absent here).
